name: foyer
description: a grand entrance hall with a black-and-white marble floor. a dusty crystal chandelier hangs precariously overhead, cobwebs draping from its arms. a sweeping staircase curves upward into darkness. to the east, a heavy oak door leads to the library; to the west, a door opens into the dining room. the massive oak front door is directly ahead, barred by an intricate locking mechanism with a skull-shaped indentation at its center. the air is stale and bitingly cold.

items.name: chandelier
items.description: a crystal chandelier thick with cobwebs. it creaks ominously above you, swaying slightly despite no draft.

items.name: rug
items.description: a faded persian rug covering most of the floor.

items.name: matches
items.description: a small box of matches has fallen from the coat pocket — a matchbox with a faded illustration of a raven. it rattles — there are several inside.

items.name: dust
items.description: a thick layer of dust covers everything. no one has been here in months

items.name: vase
items.description: a cracked porcelain vase on a side table. it's empty and smells faintly of old flowers. a hairline fracture runs down its side.

items.name: calling_cards
items.description: a small silver tray on the entrance table. several yellowed calling cards sit on it:

exits.description: a door with a tarnished brass knob that feels cold to the touch.
the massive oak front door, reinforced with iron bands. it is barred from the inside with a strange mechanism. a skull-shaped indentation suggests something must be placed here to unlock it.
a grand staircase leading up into impenetrable darkness. the steps creak under the slightest weight.
a heavy oak door with a brass handle tarnished to a sickly green.
